about.title: About Us
about.text1: MUDROCH MOTORWORXX is a professional mobile car service located in Bratislava - Podunajské Biskupice.
about.text2: We specialize primarily in timing belt/chain and brake replacement. On top of that, we take full care of your vehicle – from diagnostics and suspension to inspection preparation.
